title: Knowledge
subtitle: Important details from your conversations are organized here automatically. Read or edit them anytime.
composeHint: Give the page a focused title and choose relevant sources. Generated content goes to review before publication and memory retrieval.
personalSourceScope: Using personal memories. Select a project in the sidebar to include its sources.
projectSourceScope: Choose confirmed memories from this project and your personal context. Unavailable sources are excluded.
noCompileSources: There are no eligible confirmed sources in this scope yet.
selectionUnavailable: Some previous sources are not loaded or no longer available. Load more, or clear the selection and choose again.
costConsent: I confirm using these sources for a model call, which may incur a cost. The result will still require review.
disabled: Wiki compilation is not enabled for this account. Existing pages remain readable.
evidenceHint: Citations preserve exact source excerpts. Select a number in the article to inspect its evidence.
staleHint: Supporting sources have changed, become unavailable or been forgotten. The old body and citations are withheld from reading and retrieval. Choose current sources to recompile.
relatedHint: These pages share currently valid sources with this page.
noRelated: No pages in the loaded library share a source with this page.
reviewHint: Check the generated content against its evidence before adding it to the library.
noReview: There are no pages awaiting review.
previousUnavailable: The published version is unavailable or stale; its old body is withheld.
approvalHint: Only the candidate version you reviewed will be published.
reviewLimit: Showing the latest 100 candidates. Select a project to narrow the scope.
graphHint: Explore pages connected by shared evidence. Edges indicate common sources, not causal relationships. Select a node to read a page.
emptyGraph: Compile and publish pages to explore their connections here.
graphDiagram: Wiki pages connected by shared sources
noConnections: These pages do not share sources yet. Each node still opens its page.
graphLimit: Displaying {{count}} pages (up to 40); only current pages are connected.
readOnlyHint: Browsing, searching and inspecting sources do not call a model.
noMatchesHint: Try another keyword or status, or change the project scope.
emptyTitle: Give your knowledge a place to grow
emptyHint: Start with confirmed memories and compile your first source-grounded Wiki page.
staleCard: Sources have changed. Update this page from current evidence.
entryHint: Important details from your conversations are organized here automatically. Read or edit them anytime.

job.pending: Queued for compilation. Review the result below when ready.
job.running: Compiling a page from the selected sources…
job.completed: Compilation complete. Review the candidate before publishing.
job.failed: Compilation failed. Check the sources before trying again.

unchanged: Sources and compilation settings are unchanged. Reusing the current page without a model call.
overBudget: The selected sources exceed the compilation budget. Select fewer sources and try again.
conceptsHint: Topics, categories and aliases extracted from current sources. Human edits survive subsequent organization.
noConcepts: No concepts yet. Preview your sources under Organize to get started.
mergeHint: Merging keeps the target identity and aliases. Affected pages need recompilation and review.
mergeConcept: Merge and mark pages for update
organizeHint: Discover and reconcile concepts, reuse unchanged extractions, and generate topic page proposals for review.
skippedSources: {{count}} sources cannot be used. This run will remain partial; correct the sources or narrow the scope.
runNeedsAttention: This run needs attention. Check the sources and progress.
needsSelectionHint: Some concepts exceed the per-page source limit. Open Compile page and select up to 12 relevant memories. Completed proposals remain available for review.
maintenanceHint: When enabled, new and corrected confirmed sources trigger organization. A rolling 24-hour budget includes retries. Disabling cancels queued work from this policy.
semanticRelationsHint: Relations are grounded in source evidence. Model proposals need human review. Shared-source links are shown separately.
unresolvedRelation: The target concept is unresolved; this relation cannot be confirmed yet.
semanticLegend: Solid: confirmed. Dashed: proposed. {{count}} nodes shown (up to 40). The list below shows relation direction.
exchangeHint: Export current knowledge, sources and relations in the selected scope. Every format uses the same permission checks.
importHint: Choose an OKF 0.1 ZIP bundle (up to 8 MB). Imported documents await review and do not overwrite existing pages.
foreignAuthorityHint: Foreign citations, relations and workflow history remain exchange metadata. Local publication requires your approval.
importConflict: A page already uses this identifier. Rename the imported document or reject the proposal.
acknowledgeImportWarnings: I reviewed missing references or producer hash differences and approve publication of the imported document as supplied.
profilesHint: Define knowledge types, fields, relations, lifecycles and review stages. Existing runs require adaptation after definition changes.
unavailableRecords: {{count}} records have unavailable sources or definitions
workflowHint: Each stage declares the types it reads and writes. Submit outputs for review, then advance after the current version satisfies its gates.
noProfiles: Create a profile under Profiles and types first.
stageOutputsHint: This stage requires at least {{count}} outputs. Add and submit them; approval is bound to that exact version.
approvalBindingHint: Submitted outputs are shown below. Changes to outputs, resuming a run or adapting definitions require renewed approval.
adaptationHint: Compare the definitions first. Adaptation preserves completed stages and resets approvals for pending outputs.
approveAdaptation: I reviewed the changes and agree to continue with the new definition
adaptationBlocked: Stage order or completed-stage rules are incompatible. Keep this history and start a new run with the updated profile.

importWarningCodes.producer_hash_mismatch: Producer digest differs from imported body

platformErrors.wiki_organization_budget_exhausted: Call budget exhausted. Progress is saved; increase the total limit to continue.
platformErrors.wiki_maintenance_budget_exhausted: The rolling maintenance budget is exhausted.
platformErrors.wiki_organization_inputs_changed: Sources changed. Refresh the preview and start a new incremental run.
platformErrors.wiki_organization_preview_changed: Sources changed since the preview. Refresh it before continuing.
platformErrors.wiki_organization_selection_required: Some sources exceed the limit. Select relevant sources and compile the page separately.
platformErrors.wiki_organization_changed: Run progress changed. Refresh and retry.
platformErrors.wiki_concept_alias_conflict: The name or alias belongs to another concept. Consider merging them.
platformErrors.wiki_concept_changed: The concept changed. Reopen it before editing.
platformErrors.wiki_maintenance_changed: Maintenance settings changed. Refresh and retry.
platformErrors.wiki_maintenance_disabled: Maintenance is disabled and its tasks have stopped.
platformErrors.wiki_workflow_changed: Workflow version changed. Refresh the run.
platformErrors.wiki_workflow_gate_required: Approve the current stage outputs first.
platformErrors.wiki_workflow_outputs_required: This stage needs more valid outputs.
platformErrors.wiki_workflow_output_changed: Outputs changed. Review and approve the new version.
platformErrors.wiki_workflow_task_incomplete: The background task has not completed. Check its status.
platformErrors.wiki_workflow_definition_changed: The profile changed. Review the adaptation preview first.
platformErrors.wiki_profile_invalid: Invalid profile. Check fields, states and stage references.
platformErrors.wiki_profile_unsupported_field: The profile contains unsupported declarations. Start from the provided template.
platformErrors.wiki_record_page_unavailable: The page changed, is unavailable, or is outside the scope. Select it again.
platformErrors.wiki_record_changed: The record changed. Submit against its current version.
platformErrors.wiki_record_transition_required: Change lifecycle states with a lifecycle transition output.
platformErrors.wiki_workflow_write_denied: This stage may not write that type. Check the profile.
platformErrors.wiki_exchange_target_conflict: The page identifier exists. Rename the imported document first.
platformErrors.wiki_exchange_document_changed: The import proposal changed. Review it again.
platformErrors.wiki_exchange_warnings_require_review: Review and acknowledge the import warnings first.
platformErrors.wiki_exchange_unsafe_path: The bundle contains an unsafe or invalid path.
platformErrors.wiki_exchange_size_limit: The bundle exceeds file, expanded size or compression ratio limits.
platformErrors.wiki_exchange_version_unsupported: Only OKF 0.1 is supported. Check the bundle version.
platformErrors.wiki_exchange_index_required: The bundle root is missing index.md.
platformErrors.wiki_exchange_export_limit: The export exceeds the limit. Narrow the project scope.

unavailableLink: This linked target is unreviewed or no longer available

consumer.subtitle: Important details from your conversations are organized here automatically. Read or edit them anytime.
consumer.saved: Saved. Related knowledge will update in the background.
consumer.emptyHint: Chat naturally or add a note. Your knowledge will appear here once it has been organized.
consumer.editHint: When something changes, open its page and edit it.
consumer.editorHint: Write in your own words. Related knowledge updates automatically after you save.
consumer.conflict: The content has changed. Keep your edits and reopen this page before saving to avoid overwriting another change.
consumer.staleHint: The original information has changed or is unavailable. It will be checked again automatically; outdated content is excluded from answers.

documents.title: Upload documents
documents.hint: PDFs with selectable text, Word, TXT, Markdown, CSV and HTML. Up to 10 MB per file. We organize them automatically and keep the originals.
documents.accepted: Added to your knowledge library. Organization continues automatically; duplicate uploads reuse the existing file.
documents.failedHint: We could not finish organizing this file. Please retry.

status.index_failed: Ready to read; search preparation failed

errors.document_size_limit: Choose a nonempty file no larger than 10 MB.
errors.document_format_unsupported: Upload a PDF, DOCX, TXT, Markdown, CSV or HTML file.
errors.document_encoding_unsupported: Save the text file as UTF-8 and upload it again.
errors.document_invalid_text: The file does not contain readable text.
errors.document_password_protected: Upload an unlocked copy of this password-protected PDF.
errors.document_ocr_required: This PDF contains scanned image pages. Upload a searchable PDF or Word file.
errors.document_text_limit: Split documents containing more than 500,000 characters.
errors.document_page_limit: Split PDFs with more than 300 pages.
errors.document_parse_limit: The file structure is too complex. Try saving as Word or plain text.
errors.document_page_too_complex: A PDF page is too complex. Try saving another copy.
errors.document_archive_too_large: The Word file is too large after decompression.
errors.document_parse_failed: The file could not be read. Check that it is complete and retry.
errors.document_storage_unavailable: File storage is temporarily unavailable. Please retry later.
errors.document_processing_failed: Processing failed temporarily. We will retry automatically.
